evidence.statement: No evidence is claimed. None has been reviewed.

interpretation.meaning: The signed time in minutes from the recorded HbA1c collection time to the recorded creatinine collection time (positive when creatinine was collected later), and which was collected first. A missing time is never treated as zero.
prohibited: Do not read the gap as a statement about the quality or timeliness of care.
Do not use any output as a recommendation, alert or order.

items: A missing diabetes collection time gives needs-data; a missing kidney collection time gives indeterminate, because the kidney context is optional in the group and its absence must never read as normal.
It reads the recorded collection times only; no evaluation time is used.
limitations.statement: Describes when samples were recorded as collected. It says nothing about any value, about the quality or timeliness of care, or about a trend, and it is not decision support.

manifest.name: Diabetes and CKD: sample collection gap

population: People recorded as having diabetes, chronic kidney disease, or both. Narrowing is for the local clinician to declare.

provenance.basis: None. No clinical source and no clinical review.
provenance.origin: Synthetic demonstration written for the second demo (row 4.5d).

question: For this case, how far apart were the HbA1c sample and the creatinine sample recorded as collected, and which came first?
